items.rationale: The model keeps nothing between calls; the program resends the message list, which includes step 1's result, on every call. Choosing a shows the belief that the model holds a running memory of the conversation.
Call 1 reads 2,100 tokens, then 2,600, 3,100 and 3,600. The sum is 11,400. An answer of 3,600 counts only the final context; an answer of 8,400 repeats the first call four times.

A risky permission is decided by the authoritative record, read through a tool at the moment of the decision. A note is a copy of the student's claim and can be stale or wrong; asking again or checking afterwards still lets a claim decide the booking.

Information that must survive both compaction and the end of the session has to live in storage outside the context window. The first message, a summary and an old tool result are all inside the window and can be dropped or lost when the window is rebuilt or the session ends.
Loading whole costs 5 x 90,000 = 450,000 tokens. Retrieval costs 5 x (3 x 500) = 7,500 tokens. The difference is 442,500 tokens.
